title: Depressed_Rabbit's FNAF pack
description: a historical FNAF roleplay setting plus survival compatible content
body:
THIS IS AN OFFICAL PORT TO MODRINTH I AM THE OWNER OF THE ORIGINAL CURSEFORGE PACK

credit for icon: https://www.deviantart.com/nightmaretoychica00

FORMERLY: Historical Fnaf Roleplay Pack

IMPORTANT: this modpack requires at minium 7gb of ram to run at the barebones specs without shaders
the shader packs present vary from 2gb GPU support to 6gb GPU support
your computer must have atleast 16gb of onboard ram to have enough for this modpack
if textures are missing after an update delete and reinstall the entirepack to restore them (known issue with connected textures)



NOTE(curseforge only): when playing 4.5 remove smooth doors, when playing 4.4 remove MsPehuki to play with vanilla height properly 



This Modpack focuses on allowing you and your friends to either roleplay or do the fnafverse story mode while doing survival, maybe all three together.

the mod features MTS/IV UNU verse vehicles from the 1930s to 1980s, features tacz gun system for use in survival as some of the animtronics can and will one-tap you in melee range. features a horror mod that only adds structures and blocks (RATED M). it is also a mix-up of many other stand alone FNAF mods such multiverse of freddy and management wanted as the two biggest ones! (also features some of their side content) finally it has parcool, farmer's delgiht, and the ecology mod to let you be able to have many biomes and blocks to build your world with.



(also features a mixture of deco block mods and macaw's item mods)
